findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_timing_month, get_daily_focus · Private data: get_timing_year, get_daily_focus, compare_dates, get_sky_overview, get_life_chapters · Public sink: get_profile, get_timing_month.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_timing_month, get_daily_focus · Private data: get_timing_year, get_daily_focus, compare_dates, get_sky_overview, get_life_chapters · Public sink: get_profile, get_timing_month

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
